column1: # EPathMap setSubtrie: reconstructed topology/value reinsertion versus native PathMap zipper graft.
# Experiment checkpoint: cc6f7e94b. Selected production checkpoint: 366786fdf.
# Host: AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 5975WX, 32 physical cores, SMT disabled; CPU 8 pinned.
# Preflight: 53.30% aggregate idle; CPU 8 was 85.95% idle; 49 GiB available memory; zero swap used.
# Command: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=8G -p MemorySwapMax=0 taskset -c 8 cargo bench -j 4 -p models --bench epathmap_setsubtrie_graft --features epathmap-setsubtrie-differential
# Design: 60 retained paired/interleaved samples after 10 warmups per cell; arm order rotated each repetition; exactly one run.
# Fixture: 2,048 replaced split entries and 2,048 unrelated entries; set, map/64-byte-value, and map/4,096-byte-value cells.
# Scope: split-only timing corpus because the predecessor panics on valid bare-source terminal extension; that totality repair is tested separately and is not credited to performance.

# Correctness: exact EntryTrie and EPM1 equality asserted before timing; experimental differential 9/9 passed. Selected model 8/8, Rholang setSubtrie 5/5, and standalone trie-entry invariant 8/8 suites pass; strict models Clippy passes.

# Robustness: Cliff's delta=-1.0; Mann-Whitney p=0.0. Both arms depart from normality; the nonparametric result agrees. Every paired alpha=0.01 cell interval excludes zero in the predicted direction.
